title: Choose the composition of S4Quota
question: Three related ways to compose Main and Compact inside the approved Tidal Almanac system. Choose the structure that should become the final Light/Dark specimen set.

options.label: Capacity Fold
options.lineage: Measured field with an expanded limiting band
options.thesis: The limiting five-hour window opens into the primary reading while the weekly horizon remains attached below it.
options.viewport: Main is a 960 × 680 field with a 5h band occupying the upper reading zone; Compact is a 304 × 132 slice with 72% first, 02:14 second, and one quiet rail.
options.risk: The rail must remain subordinate or the surface starts reading as monitoring software.

options.label: Limiting Spine
options.lineage: A vertical reading spine linking now, reset, and the secondary window
options.thesis: One strong vertical alignment makes the limiting condition readable as a continuous sequence rather than a collection of metrics.
options.viewport: Main uses a 920 × 700 register with the primary percentage and reset on one spine; Compact is a 272 × 144 upright instrument without a chart.
options.risk: The taller Compact footprint is less discreet near a screen corner.

options.label: Optical Index
options.lineage: A disciplined index whose dominant row expands only as much as the data needs
options.thesis: A compact register makes window comparison immediate and produces the quietest always-on-top surface.
options.viewport: Main is a 900 × 640 optical ledger; Compact is a 264 × 104 number-and-countdown strip with no default chart.
options.risk: Extreme restraint can understate the cyclical-capacity idea if the reset boundary is not explicit enough.
